title: Member Notice on Cash Patronage Payments — Payment Dates, Payout Methods and the Election Cutoff, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
Cash patronage declared for a year is paid on that year's payment date, in one payout per Member Equities & Patronage Qualified Allocated Surplus holding for the whole year's cash.

## Terms of payment

- **Payment dates.** Cash declared for patronage year 2024 is paid on 14 March 2025; cash declared for patronage year 2025 is paid on 13 March 2026.
- **The whole year's cash.** The payout is the year's cash payable on the holding: the cash declared for that year plus any voided payouts of that year, less what has already been paid for that year.
- **Method.** The payout is made by the payment method on the holding: a check, a direct deposit to the account ending in the last four digits recorded for it, or a principal payment applied to the loan named for it.
- **Election cutoff.** A payment method change recorded later than 15 calendar days before the payment date applies from the next payout.
- **Cash applied to a loan.** Cash applied to a loan is booked on the loan as a principal payment; when that loan is no longer in an open status on the payment date, the cash is paid by check instead.
- **Minimum payout.** A year's cash below the class's minimum cash payout is not paid out but retained in Qualified Allocated Surplus.

## Election cutoff illustrated (payment date 13 March 2026)

| Change of method recorded on | Days before the payment date | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| 26 February 2026 | 15 | The 13 March 2026 payout |
| 27 February 2026 | 14 | The next payout |

## Hypothetical payouts

- A Qualified Allocated Surplus holding with USD 1,870.00 declared for 2025 and set to direct deposit receives one direct deposit of USD 1,870.00 on 13 March 2026.
- A holding set to apply cash to an operating line that was closed before 13 March 2026 is paid by check on that date.
- A holding whose year's cash is USD 8.25, below the USD 10 minimum of Qualified Allocated Surplus, has the USD 8.25 retained in Qualified Allocated Surplus.
